items.answer: Luwei is a Chinese braising tradition used for meats, tofu, vegetables, and other ingredients. Aromatic spices and a seasoned braising liquid create layered, savory flavor. It can be enjoyed as a snack, side, or part of a complete meal.
items.question: What is Chinese luwei?

items.answer: Chinese luwei is prepared by braising ingredients in a seasoned broth with aromatic spices, allowing the flavor to build throughout each bite. Keke Food offers duck, chicken, pork, beef, tofu, and vegetable selections in both spicy and five-spice styles.
items.question: What makes Chinese luwei distinctive?

items.answer: Not every luwei dish is spicy. Keke Food offers chili-forward options such as spicy duck neck and mala dishes, along with aromatic five-spice selections such as whole chicken, pork ears, and beef. Check each menu description when choosing your preferred flavor.

reviews.comment: 环境卫生，四菜一汤菜品也不错，我喜欢它家的卤味，希望多出一些新品，兔子肉卤味

reviews.comment: 今天买了卤全鸡、豬耳朵、海帶丝，咸淡适宜，食材新鮮，色香味俱全，卤鸡有点儿半熏半鹵，豬耳朵很糯很软的口感，胶原蛋白滿滿，海带丝有一点儿微酸，挺开胃。

reviews.comment: 第一次吃他们家的夫妻肺片味道在美国基本上吃不到这个味儿，太怀恋了。又来买第二次…鸭脖还有卤鸡好吃又划算😘😘

reviews.comment: 以前一直在Weee平台下单购买香辣卤鸡，几乎每周一次，我们全家人都爱吃！今天路过这家门店，进来看到热气腾腾的卤锅，新鲜出炉的卤鸡、猪耳、鸭脖、猪蹄，浓浓的卤香味扑鼻而来，我买了卤鸡、猪蹄、卤豆腐、四川泡菜，和新推出的夫妻肺片和椒麻鸡，在店里和2个朋友喝着冰可乐，好好享受了一顿正宗的家乡卤味。
